entries.text: Flutter basics: MaterialApp, Scaffold, AppBar, Column, Row, Container, Text, Image, ListView, GridView, ElevatedButton and TextField.
Flutter state: StatelessWidget for immutable UI descriptions and StatefulWidget for local mutable state.
Dart basics: main function, types, functions, classes, constructors, lists, maps, sets and null safety.
Android development concepts: activity, intent, manifest, permissions, resources and app lifecycle.
App Inventor concepts: components expose properties, methods and events; blocks connect logic without traditional text syntax.
